scientific_findings.summary: The frozen support and real-Y2 normalization are correct.
details: strict_integer_support returns exactly 41 through 762 inclusive: 722 integer multipoles, with 40 and 763 excluded; the feature-card cache records the same complete ordered support
strict_band_alm zero-initializes the compact alm and copies only target ell >= 41 through lmax 762

the five Cartesian real-Y2 columns match the stated Condon-Shortley combinations; independent Gauss-Legendre/azimuth quadrature gave maximum Gram-minus-identity error 1.9984014443252818e-15, maximum integral mean 7.591149930874508e-15, and maximum complex-to-real basis error 1.6653345369377348e-16

scientific_findings.summary: The fractional-variance fit, bounded mask nuisance, exchangeable LOO score, and Hartlap factor implement the frozen estimator.
details: centering the variance and normalized design columns is algebraically equivalent to fitting an intercept; solving the joint mask-plus-Y2 Gram system and dividing the Y2 coefficients by their original norms and positive mean variance returns the physical fractional-basis coefficients
all 401 units have finite 5-vectors, positive mean core variance, exact observed-plus-sim-0001..sim-0400 ordering, and mask_change exactly equal to squared norm(q_raw-q_controlled)

the mask control is limited to centered M_K squared on the identical M_K >= 0.99 core; its design condition number is 8.143549140387146 and it is correctly not described as a causal or exhaustive systematics control
for 400 reference units and dimension 5, the unbiased sample covariance denominator is 399 and the Hartlap factor is (400-5-2)/(400-1)=393/399=0.9849624060150376

independent direct delete-one mean/covariance calculations matched every raw and controlled full-sample score to at most 5.417888360170764e-14; five random permutations matched after reindexing to 1.0302869668521453e-13

scientific_findings.summary: The reported ranks and the complete 400-way delete-simulation numerical-resolution guard reproduce exactly from the pinned unit features.
details: mask change: 397 null exceedances, conservative rank 398/401=0.9925187032418953, guard [0.9815548130650192,1.0]
an independent feature-level replay removed each of sim-0001 through sim-0400, recomputed all remaining LOO transforms and ranks, and matched all 1200 reported delete ranks exactly
the independently recomputed jackknife means, extrema, standard errors, t_399 intervals, 1/401-expanded guards, and all three RESOLVED_ABOVE_ALPHA relations match every reported field exactly

this supplies the full-crossfit delete-independent-unit recomputation that PR-173 identified as required; no observed-unit deletion, iid-binomial interval, Gaussian sigma, or full-sample transform reuse is reported

the actual controlled guard lower endpoint 0.16944885802620666 is strictly above alpha=0.05, so the first resolved no-candidate branch applies regardless of the raw and mask-change directions

all three result artifacts agree on NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOLUTION and carry conditional C3, standard_internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, physical_interpretation=not_evaluated, and raw_qe_reproduced=false metadata

assumptions_used: The seven assignment inputs are the authorized evidence slice; all seven on-disk SHA-256 values matched the registered hashes.

The observed released reconstruction and 400 corresponding released reconstructions are jointly exchangeable only for this conditional empirical-rank functional; this assumption is not independently validated here.
Authenticated raw-source hashes are inherited from PR-152 and the acquisition manifest. PR-177 intentionally performs path/size checks rather than rehashing the approximately 64 GB raw payload.

The unit-local q vectors are deletion-invariant sufficient statistics for the specified finite-ensemble recomputation; the audit independently recomputed ensemble-dependent transforms from those pinned vectors.
The Student-t jackknife interval is interpreted only as the preregistered numerical-resolution guard, not as physical uncertainty or validated external coverage.

reproduction_recipe: Load q_raw, q_controlled, and mask_change from the 401 ordered feature-card units.

For each unit i, form the other-unit mean and unbiased covariance, apply h=(N_ref-5-2)/(N_ref-1), solve the five-dimensional quadratic form, and rank unit 0 against units 1..N-1 with conservative greater-equal ties and the self count.

For each simulation k=1..400, remove k, recompute every remaining mean/covariance/score/rank from the retained primitive vectors, then apply sqrt((399/400)*sum((p_k-mean(p))^2)), t_399=1.965927295920882, and the 1/401 finite-grid expansion.
Enumerate eligibility false/true and all 3^3 controlled/raw/mask relations against the frozen terminal table.
